entities.summary: Lars Filip Dellmer Gustavsson is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Minnesota Wild of the National Hockey League (NHL). He has previously played for the Ottawa Senators and Luleå HF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Gustavsson was drafted 55th overall by the Pittsburgh Penguins in the 2016 NHL entry draft. He became the 15th goaltender in NHL history to score a goaltender goal on 15 October 2024 in the Wild's 4–1 victory over the St. Louis Blues.
